WPSS No. 3204 of 2018
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. B.D. Pande, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. Sachin Mohan Singh Mehta, Brief 
Holder for the State/respondents.
The respondent no.3 has filed a counter 
affidavit to which the petitioner has also filed 
his rejoinder. 
The matter is listed on an urgency 
application preferred by the petitioner on the 
ground that since the pleadings have already 
been exchanged and the matter is pending 
consideration ever since 14.09.2018, and as 
the issue pertains to the re-fixation of the 
salary of the petitioner, it requires an urgent 
consideration.
Having gone through the contents of the 
urgency application, the same would stand 
allowed and the writ petition is directed to be 
listed in the week commencing 21.02.2022.
All the pending applications would 
stand disposed of.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 10.01.2022
Nahid
